name: How long does a typical range hood installation take?
description: Most installations take 2-4 hours, but can be longer if new ductwork, cabinet modifications, or electrical work is needed.

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical range hood installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard range hood installation typically takes between 2 to 4 hours, assuming existing ductwork and electrical connections are in place. However, the timeline can extend if new ductwork needs to be installed, cabinet modifications are required, or electrical wiring needs to be routed. Providing clear details about your current kitchen setup and the specific range hood model helps us give a more accurate estimate during the initial consultation.
